b.regimeBugDiagnosis: DEFINITIVE cause = a same-prefill cross-run GREEDY TRAJECTORY FORK, NOT raw-vs-tokenized. Code+artifact verified: (1) BOTH probes send a RAW STRING to /v1/completions — fr10_quick_decode_tps_probe.py:166-179 sends "prompt": prompt, and fr13_gold_margin_probe.py:88 (the `capture` subcommand that produced the banked 3.161 stream) ALSO sends "prompt": prompt (raw). Only its unrelated `teacher_force` subcommand (:411, a max_tokens=1 re-prefill, not the accept run) sends tokenized ids. So the prompt's raw-vs-tokenized framing is the wrong mechanism. (2) The server tokenizes the IDENTICAL 681-token context in both runs — offline-confirmed: tok(prompt[0], add_special_tokens=True) == tok(..., False) == the phase0 record's prompt_token_ids byte-for-byte (Qwen has no BOS so add_special_tokens is a no-op; /v1/completions has no chat-template path; completion/protocol.py:88 defaults add_special_tokens=True). The prefill BYTES are identical. (3) The served greedy streams FORK: for prompt[0] both share the first 6 served ids [271,248068,271,248069,271,40] (= "</think>\n\nI") then diverge at served index 6 — phase0 -> [1144,310,3418,279,...] "I need to understand the problem...None" a DEGENERATE <think></think>...None loop accepting at 1.70; gold -> [3172,1151,539,23218,...] "I'll start by exploring..." coherent, accepting at 3.16. Each stream is WITHIN-boot deterministic (all 4 phase0 samples byte-identical; gold within_boot_det=[T,T,T,T]). This is the GB10 same-prefill cross-run greedy trajectory fork = the autotune/realization floor (feedback_no_cross_boot_byte_gate), forking as early as token 6, AMPLIFIED by the differing harness regime: fr13_speed_phase0.sh:60-63 fires a /v1/chat/completions chat-templated warmup before the probe (the gold-gate does none), plus samples_per_prompt=4 vs 1 and MAX_NUM_SEQS=4 (launcher default) vs 1 (gold/current-gate bind) — any of which perturbs the per-step bf16/fp8 realization enough to flip the early near-tie argmax and fork the whole trajectory. Binding lesson (bug-class #12 "non-like-for-like trajectories"): accept/event is TRAJECTORY-DEPENDENT and is not apple-to-apple across two free-running boots; s/fwd is trajectory-robust (per-event decode time, ~length-invariant) which is why Phase-0 s/fwd MATCHED (native 0.2159, cat9 0.2241) while only accept forked.
b.infraDesign: ONE canonical entry point scripts/fr13_measure.py with subcommands: speed (OFF-mode s/fwd + accept/event + committed + derived-TPS), capture-q (ON-mode full-stream spec verify dist q = the NEW piece), temp06-drift (CPU reduce of per-position TV(softmax(q/0.6),softmax(p/0.6)) + KL + over-floor vector vs the recurrent oracle p), bag-tv (multi-seed realized bag-TV with p95 native floor), diag-residue (OFF-vs-ON s/fwd instrument tax), reconcile (measured OFF speed vs banked). The canonical regime is BAKED as module constants (CANONICAL_PROMPTS=output/fr13_acceptance_ladder/prompts_swe4.json, CANONICAL_SEED=1313, CANONICAL_MAX_TOKENS=128) and as subcommand defaults (temp0/top_p1 greedy for speed, temp0.6/top_p0.95 for capture-q, /v1/completions raw prompt, ONE raw self-warm NOT chat-template + reset_prefix_cache). parse_arm() resolves ANY arm: native_eN (N=3..8, mode naive_mtp, expected tok/draft N) or a TREE caterpillar (--tree '[(0,),...]', mode tree_mtp, expected tok/draft len(TREE)); an unbuilt shape FAILS LOUD at parse (tree arm without --tree) and at the engagement assert (tok/draft != len(TREE)). Every record carries {"kind","instrument"} so SPEED(OFF) and lossless/drift(ON) can never be mixed (assert_no_mode_mix raises). accept/event is bound to a served_stream_fingerprint and labelled trajectory-bound.

b.speedAccounting: s/fwd = d(vllm:request_decode_time_seconds_sum)/d(vllm:spec_decode_num_drafts_total) — decode-only, per spec-event, RAW /metrics counter delta, ~B-invariant for bandwidth-bound GB10 B=1 (cmd_speed). accept/event = d(vllm:spec_decode_num_accepted_tokens_total)/d(spec_drafts) labelled B-DEPENDENT (co-residency degrades it: B=1 and B=4 are different numbers, both stamped with batch_size) AND trajectory-bound (stamped with served_stream_fingerprint, with an explicit accept_per_event_note: not apple-to-apple across boots, bug-class #12). committed/event = accept+1. derived_tps = committed/event ÷ s_fwd, emitted with derived_tps_note "DERIVED ... NOT measured". B=1 is SEQUENTIAL. BANNED forms (tps/accept/wall/wall_clock/req_elapsed/http_elapsed) are blocked in assert_speed_basis() which raises if asked to report any as the basis (speed --basis is validated on every speed run). INSTRUMENT ON/OFF separation: mode=OFF = clean deployment (FR10_METRICS=0, NO logprobs/q-capture/probe/FR12-13 diag) is the ONLY source of SPEED — cmd_speed stamps instrument=OFF and sends no logprobs; mode=ON = capture-q (top-K logprobs + DtoH tax) is the ONLY source of lossless/drift — stamps instrument=ON. assert_no_mode_mix() raises if a speed record is ON or a lossless/drift record is OFF (every record records its mode). diag-residue computes the per-arm tax (on_s_fwd-off_s_fwd)/off_s_fwd from the ON capture's raw_counter_delta vs the OFF s/fwd, expectation <=2.5% (46e89f22) MEASURED via tax_within_expectation not assumed; the ON s/fwd is used ONLY for this tax, never as the deployment speed.
